title: Microsoft Exchange ProxyShell / ProxyNotShell
description: On-premises Microsoft Exchange servers running vulnerable, unpatched builds are susceptible to chained vulnerabilities (ProxyShell: CVE-2021-34473/34523/31207; ProxyNotShell: CVE-2022-41040/41082) that allow an attacker to reach privileged endpoints and achieve remote code execution. Exchange is a high-value target that frequently yields domain-level access.
businessImpact: Critical --- exploitation can lead to remote code execution on the Exchange server, mailbox access, and privilege escalation toward domain compromise.
remediation:
- Apply the latest Exchange cumulative and security updates for all affected servers.
- Apply Microsoft-recommended URL rewrite / interim mitigations until patched.
- Restrict external access to administrative endpoints (ECP) and consider Exchange Online migration.
- Hunt for web shells and indicators of compromise on Exchange servers.
